name: Richard Lionheart
bible: A young knight-king and master swordsman with a disciplined, noble fighting style. Golden-blond hair, swept back and wild, falling to the jaw at the back; determined blue eyes; a handsome, focused face. Regal polished SILVER plate armour with GOLD trim and engraved gold filigree: layered rounded pauldrons, a breastplate, articulated gauntlets, greaves and pointed sabatons. NAVY-BLUE undersuit and trousers showing at the joints and thighs. A long IVORY tabard with gold embroidery hangs front and back from a dark belt with a gold buckle. A long CRIMSON cape with a gold border and a slightly tattered hem flows from the shoulders. WEAPON: an ornate longsword with a golden LION-HEAD crossguard, a navy-and-gold wrapped grip and pommel with a blue gem, and a steel blade with a glowing sapphire-blue fuller. He grips it in his RIGHT hand; the left hand joins on the grip for heavy two-handed strikes. His sword energy and weapon trails are GOLDEN sunlight arcs with white-hot cores and gold sparks (the sun crescent he flings is the same gold).

sheetNotes.art: Radiant Cleave: he gathers blue-white and gold light into the sword (anticipation), then hurls a huge crescent wave of blue-white light forward with a mighty horizontal sweep (execution), the wave leaving the blade toward the right edge of the cell; recovery with the sword lowered, light motes fading.
sheetNotes.misc: Taunt: he points the sword forward at the opponent, then raises his chin with a confident half-smile. Victory: he plants the sword point-down in front of him with both hands on the lion crossguard, cape flowing, a regal calm look; a soft blue-gold glow.
sheetNotes.ko: Intro: he walks in with the sword lowered at his side, raises it in a knightly salute before his face, swings it down in a flourish, and takes his stance.
sheetNotes.skill: Lion's Roar, his own special (a royal war cry that throws close enemies back). 1: he plants his feet and lifts the longsword high overhead, blade vertical, chin up, mouth opening for a shout. 2: the sword drawn back beside his head, the sapphire fuller and gold sparks gathering, the cape snapping out. 3: he drives the blade down in front of his chest and roars, a golden LION-SHAPED shockwave bursting outward from him in gold and blue-white rings. 4: the roar at full force, the lion-head wave filling the cell out to its margin, his body braced, the cape flaring back. 5: the wave fading into drifting gold sparks, the sword lowering. 6: back in stance with the blade held across the body.
sheetNotes.alt-a: THIS SHEET SHOWS HIS/HER SECOND FIGHTING STANCE. In EVERY frame the weapon is a huge two-handed DANISH WAR-AXE: a long ash haft wrapped in red leather and a broad crescent steel head engraved with a gold lion - NOT the usual weapon from the reference images (the costume, face, hair and colours stay exactly as the reference). How it is held: both hands on the long haft; his longsword is sheathed at the hip and NOT drawn.

atk-a.title: Lionheart's royal cuts 1 and 2 (4 frames each)
frames: combo strike 1, wind-up: a quick step in on the front foot, the sword drawn back low across the body in the right hand, the left hand open for balance, the crimson cape trailing

combo strike 1, strike: a fast rising diagonal cut from low left to high right, the blade a blur, a crisp golden sunlight arc with a white-hot core and a motion smear of the swing, kept inside this cell
combo strike 1, follow-through: the sword carried high above the right shoulder at the end of the cut, the body turned with it, the golden trail thinning out behind (kept inside this cell)
combo strike 1, recovery: the sword coming back down to a guard in front of the chest, the cape settling
combo strike 2, wind-up: the sword raised high over the left shoulder, weight shifting onto the back foot, eyes locked forward
combo strike 2, strike: a hard downward diagonal cut across the body from high left to low right, a broad golden arc with a white-hot core and a motion smear of the swing, kept inside this cell
combo strike 2, follow-through: the sword low by the right knee at the end of the cut, the body leaning into it, the golden trail fading (kept inside this cell)
combo strike 2, recovery: rising back to the fighting stance, the sword level and ready

atk-b.title: Royal finisher and aerial cut (4 frames each)
frames: combo finisher, wind-up: both hands on the grip, the sword pulled far back behind the right hip, a long lunge step forward, the cape flaring
combo finisher, strike: a lunging two-handed horizontal sweep at full extension, a huge golden arc with a white-hot core and a motion smear, gold sparks, the strongest pose, kept inside this cell
combo finisher, follow-through: the sword swept all the way round past the left side, the body twisted with the swing, the golden arc dissolving into sparks (kept inside this cell)
combo finisher, recovery: pulling back into a proud stance, the sword lowered, the cape drifting down
aerial attack, wind-up: in mid-air, knees tucked, the sword raised high behind the head with both hands
aerial attack, strike: a sweeping mid-air cut in front and downward, a golden crescent arc with a motion smear, kept inside this cell
aerial attack, follow-through: still airborne, the sword at the bottom of the swing in front of the hips, the trail fading (kept inside this cell)
aerial attack, recovery: airborne, the sword drawn back to a ready guard, the cape billowing upward

atk-c.title: Plunge and the Sun Crescent heavy (4 frames each)
frames: plunge, dive: in mid-air diving straight down, both hands driving the sword point down beneath the body, gold speed lines
plunge, impact: landed in a low crouch, the sword driven into the ground in front, a burst of golden light and dust, kept inside this cell
plunge, settle: still low, the sword planted, golden embers and dust spreading out from the impact (kept inside this cell)
plunge, recovery: pulling the sword free and rising back toward stance
Sun Crescent, wind-up: both hands on the grip, the sword raised high above the head, the blade gathering bright golden sunlight, the body coiled on the back foot

Sun Crescent, strike: a huge two-handed overhead cleave down and forward, the swing releasing a tall CRESCENT of golden light that leaves the blade and flies forward, a motion smear of the swing, kept inside this cell

Sun Crescent, follow-through: the sword low in front after the cleave, the body leaning far forward, the golden crescent just separating from the blade and flying off toward the right edge of the cell (kept inside this cell)
Sun Crescent, recovery: straightening up from the cleave, the sword brought back to guard, golden sparks drifting
